descriptions: A shingle shore at the edge of a wide grey mere. The far side is lost in mist.
features: An upturned boat, its keel green with weed.
ambient: Wind ruffles the water into small grey waves.

descriptions: Knee-deep water over soft mud, with the bottom shelving away into darkness.
Warm shallows full of weed that wraps your ankles.
A ruined boathouse, its roof fallen in, its slipway cracked.
A boathouse on piles, the boats long gone. The water under the floor is black.
features: A rotten oar with a name burnt into it.

descriptions: A holt of pollard willows, their heads bristling with new shoots.
Old willows with hollow trunks big enough to stand in.
features: A hollow willow with a nest of rags inside.

descriptions: A lane that once ran between hedges, now under a foot of water. The hedgetops stick out like green islands.
The tops of fence posts mark a road that went somewhere, once.
features: A milestone, just showing above the water.
ambient: A bell rings under the water, or you imagine it.

descriptions: A long spit of gravel running out into the mere, with water on both sides.
A narrow spit where the gulls stand all facing the same way.
ambient: A gull screams and wheels away.
